rules.expr: histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (env, le) (increase(manijero_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/ask"}[15m]))) and on (env) (manijero:ask_requests_15m > 0)

((max by (env) (up) == 0) * 0 + 2) or (((max by (env) (up) == 1) and on (env) (max by (env) (manijero_ready) == 0)) * 0 + 3) or (((max by (env) (up) == 1) and on (env) (max by (env) (manijero_ready) == 1) and on (env) ((min by (env) (min_over_time(up[5m])) == 0) or (min by (env) (min_over_time(manijero_ready[5m])) == 0))) * 0 + 1) or (((max by (env) (up) == 1) and on (env) (max by (env) (manijero_ready) == 1)) * 0) or (absent(up{env="qa"}) * 4)

((max by (env) (manijero_knowledge_ops_configured) == 0) * 0 + 4) or ((max by (env) (manijero_knowledge_ops_last_run_outcome{outcome=~"failed|stopped_at_time_limit|interrupted"}) == 1) * 0 + 2) or (((time() - max by (env) (manijero_knowledge_ops_last_run_finished_timestamp_seconds)) > 108000) * 0 + 1) or ((max by (env) (manijero_knowledge_ops_last_run_outcome{outcome="review_ready"}) == 1) * 0) or (max by (env) (manijero_knowledge_ops_configured) * 0 - 1)

((max by (env) (manijero_nightly_eval_configured) == 0) * 0 + 4) or ((max by (env) (manijero_nightly_eval_last_run_outcome{outcome=~"failed|stopped_at_time_limit|interrupted"}) == 1) * 0 + 2) or (((time() - max by (env) (manijero_nightly_eval_last_run_finished_timestamp_seconds)) > 108000) * 0 + 1) or ((max by (env) (manijero_nightly_eval_score_dropped) == 1) * 0 + 3) or ((max by (env) (manijero_nightly_eval_last_run_outcome{outcome="evaluated"}) == 1) * 0) or (max by (env) (manijero_nightly_eval_configured) * 0 - 1)
